distribution.narrative: Cao et al. (2024) reports Scolytus pubescens as a new record for China based on specimens collected in Shandong (Jinan, Panlongshan Forest Park) and Heilongjiang (Yichun, Liangshui Experimental Forest Farm). These records establish confirmed mainland-China occurrence.

host_note: Cao et al. (2024) explicitly reports 榆, Ulmus sp., as the host. This genus-level host identification is retained at the same taxonomic resolution in the current synthesis.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytus pubescens Stark, 1936.

nomenclature_note: The 2024 paper uses Scolytus pubescens Stark, 1936, which maps directly to the pre-existing integrated taxonomic backbone identity VSN_5552. No new taxon identity or nomenclatural change is required.
